label: Canonical bag, all algorithms (steps 1–8)
source: start_benchmark.sh on orchestration branch Oxford-Spires (commit ee3e644) with step 1 done by hand for HUMANOID-LIO (canonical bag and ROS2 bag from the Mandeye raw data; ground truth, ground-truth session and TLS map from the 2026-10-25 run); the later reruns used the Mid-360 sensor settings now committed as 308d95c on branch HUMANOID-LIO-canonical
notes: Canonical-bag route: every algorithm from its hdmapping-benchmark-canonical branch (hdmapping-lio from Bunker-DVI-Dataset-reg-1, default parameters) on a canonical bag made from the Mandeye raw data with laz_to_bag --lidar-type canonical --msg_hz 10. The data is a Livox Mid-360 with no ring channel, so every point has ring 0, while the canonical configs describe a 64-ring Hesai QT64. Full run 2026-11-03; afterwards ellipselio and nv-liom were rerun with the Mid-360 settings in sensor_overrides.conf (orchestration branch HUMANOID-LIO-canonical), and lego-loam, slict, form and d-lio were rerun on 2026-11-03/04, so those six rows are not from the original pass. No result: loam-livox (no canonical config), lego-loam (empty point clouds, no session), slict and form (sessions made, step 7 registration failed: not enough correspondences). Ground truth, ground-truth session and step 8 reference map are the 2026-10-25 run's (map_gt_0.01.laz is 1.9 MB). The ground truth starts about 10 s after the bag, so most overlap values are about 102.5%; dlo (34.6%), glim (52.7%) and voxel-slam (86.0%) are really incomplete. The hdmapping-lio row is from a rerun on 2026-11-05 on a session made from the canonical bag with bag_to_laz writing 10 s chunks (HDMapping branch converters-10s-chunks, commit b8b2f07b; previously 20 s), as the canonical pipeline does for HDMapping-LIO. lidar_odometry_step_1 never uses a session's first file, so the chunk length sets how much of the start is lost; the first run of this row read the raw Mandeye recording directly and scored APE RMSE 0.0322 m.
